colours.sql: WITH palette(Category, r, g, b) AS (VALUES ('IFCWALL', 31, 119, 180), ('IFCWALLSTANDARDCASE', 174, 199, 232), ('IFCSLAB', 127, 127, 127), ('IFCCOVERING', 219, 219, 141), ('IFCBUILDINGELEMENTPART', 140, 86, 75), ('IFCWINDOW', 44, 160, 44), ('IFCDOOR', 214, 39, 40), ('IFCBEAM', 255, 127, 14), ('IFCRAILING', 148, 103, 189), ('IFCCOLUMN', 227, 119, 194), ('IFCSTAIR', 23, 190, 207)) SELECT CAST(e.StepId AS INTEGER) AS entityId, coalesce(p.Category, 'other') AS category, coalesce(p.r, 199) / 255.0 AS r, coalesce(p.g, 199) / 255.0 AS g, coalesce(p.b, 199) / 255.0 AS b, 1.0 AS a FROM EntityText e JOIN StoreyOfElement s ON s.EntityIndex = e.EntityIndex LEFT JOIN palette p ON p.Category = e.Category WHERE e.StepId <> -1 AND e.Category <> 'IFCSPACE'
